title: AMAZING
body: "I’ve been using Me+ to help structure my day, and it is easily one of the most aesthetically pleasing and intuitive routine planners I’ve tried. The app does a fantastic job of breaking down overwhelming tasks into manageable habits, making it especially helpful for anyone dealing with ADHD or executive dysfunction who needs that extra 'nudge' to stay on track. While the customization options and mood-tracking features are top-notch, the aggressive paywall for the VIP version can be a bit frustrating for those on a budget. Overall, if you’re looking for a beautiful, all-in-one space to gamify your self-care and productivity, Me+ is definitely worth the download."

body: Overall it’s a good app, but unfortunately it’s not user friendly. My task list on the routine page doesn’t show time! Very inconvenient. Also there is no option to remind 3 times if I need to take vitamins, for example. It shows morning, afternoon and evening but only one time reminding. But my biggest issue that app doesn’t have option to plan ahead (month - anytime option) or show the task “until it’s done” - meaning if you plan to buy something, for example, you need to put same task to repeat daily not to forget. Would be easier to have a list of things that doesn’t require certain time or date but has to be done.
